# Claritia

> Claritia is the agentic marketing platform for B2B teams. It turns website visitors into leads and leads into meetings, with AI agents running the journeys, writing the emails, building the pages and proving what made revenue.

## How it works

- Website Intelligence: a small script matches companies by IP, stitches people across sessions, and raises intent as they read. No personal data is required.
- One marketing database: contacts, companies, consent and behavior in one place, with live segments built from AND/OR rules over fields, behavior and scores.
- Bring your data: import from 60+ tools, files and emails, sync HubSpot, Salesforce or Omniscient both ways, and query 7 warehouses read-only.
- Journeys with agent steps: an agent picks a branch you named and writes each email from your Brand Brain (your content, voice and proof). Every claim cites a source, or it is removed.
- Approvals first: every journey starts in review. Auto mode unlocks only after 20 approved sends with few edits.
- Consent at send time: no marketing email goes out without a lawful basis for the contact's region.
- Funnel QA: a real browser checks every page, form and email before launch, and on a schedule after.

## The suite

- Found by Arrowsterr (SEO, GEO and AI search). Converted by Claritia. Closed with Omniscient (CRM, opportunities and deal rooms).
